	else_if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_tranquility has_variable = sr_ss_cap_tranquility } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_tranquility } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_tranquility } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ruined_tranquility } value = 6 }
}

# Colonies held, in worlds (the overview's Colonies cell, Colonies Held above the
# list, the count over the Colonies window's): one for each world where either of
# its two specializations is held. A module can raise both, so the per-
# specialization sr_disp_colony_* are not summed; this never passes
# sr_sites_world_count (#2054).

# Colony fleets and population (slices 2-3 design §§ 3, 8, 10), per world:
#   sr_disp_site_target_<key>         2 our target, 1 we may target it now, 0 neither
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_<key>        fleets on their way there
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_months_<key> months until the first lands
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_ours_<key>   1 when the first is ours
#   sr_disp_site_pop_<key>            its people, whole
#   sr_disp_site_prio_<key>           our priority for it: 0 Closed, 1 Low, 2 Normal, 3 High
sr_disp_site_target_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_solar_colonization_running = yes sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_site_inbound_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris }
}
sr_disp_site_inbound_months_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris subtract = te_history_month_index }
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_inbound_ours_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_inbound_by_valles_marineris ?= this } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_site_pop_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_prio_valles_marineris = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris } value = var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris }
}

# The lunar world our Moon Landing named (design § 3.4), for its Solar System
# hover: 1 while its -25% is ours (sr_site_landing_discount_tt); 2 under races
# only while it isn't our Target, which alone pays the discount there
# (sr_site_landing_discount_target_tt).
sr_disp_site_landing_shackleton = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_moon_site_shackleton }
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes }
				NOT = { AND = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 35 } }
			}
			value = 2
		}
	}
}
sr_disp_site_landing_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_moon_site_tranquility }
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes }
				NOT = { AND = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 37 } }
			}
			value = 2
		}
	}
}

# Per fleet slot (Colony Fleets): 1 while it flies, the months until it lands,
# the share of its flight behind it, the year it lands.
sr_disp_cf_slot_1 = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_1_site has_variable = sr_cf_1_arrive } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_cf_slot_1_months = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_1_arrive } value = var:sr_cf_1_arrive subtract = te_history_month_index }
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_cf_slot_1_frac = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_1_arrive has_variable = sr_cf_1_depart }
		value = te_history_month_index
		subtract = var:sr_cf_1_depart
		# a lunar fleet lands the month it leaves: never a division by nothing
		divide = { value = var:sr_cf_1_arrive subtract = var:sr_cf_1_depart min = 1 }
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
sr_disp_cf_slot_1_year = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_1_arrive } value = var:sr_cf_1_arrive divide = 12 }
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_cf_slot_2 = {

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_2_site has_variable = sr_cf_2_arrive } value = 1 }

# Modules (slice 4 design § 11), per world:
#   sr_disp_mod_pending_<type>_<key>  our queue of the type and every shipment of it on its way
#   sr_disp_site_staffing_<key>       the colony's staffing, in percent
#   sr_site_crews_planned_<key>       the crews needed once our queue and shipments land
#   sr_disp_site_crews_fit_<key>      the crews against that: 0 spare, 1 exact, 2 short
sr_disp_mod_pending_a_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris }
}
sr_disp_mod_pending_b_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_b_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris }
}

sr_disp_site_crews_needed_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_crews_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_crews_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_crews_short_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris > sr_site_crews_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_crews_planned_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_mod_crewed_pending_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_crews_fit_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_valles_marineris = sr_site_crews_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_valles_marineris > sr_site_crews_valles_marineris } value = 2 }
}
sr_disp_site_staffing_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_hab_used_valles_marineris = { value = sr_mod_hab_used_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_hab_cap_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_hab_cap_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_mod_past_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_hab_used_valles_marineris > sr_site_hab_cap_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_valles_marineris = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_valles_marineris multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_valles_marineris multiply = sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_resort_room_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_resort_room_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_site_resort_draw_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_valles_marineris }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_valles_marineris = { value = 4 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_valles_marineris floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_valles_marineris = { value = 50000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_crews_at_cap_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_people_at_cap_valles_marineris
	divide = 10000
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } multiply = 2 }
	floor = yes
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_amalthea } add = var:sr_mq_culture_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_amalthea }
}

sr_disp_site_crews_needed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_crew_needed_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_crews_amalthea = { value = sr_site_crews_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_crews_short_amalthea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crew_needed_amalthea > sr_site_crews_amalthea } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_crews_planned_amalthea = {
	value = sr_mod_crewed_pending_amalthea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_crews_fit_amalthea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_amalthea = sr_site_crews_amalthea } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_amalthea > sr_site_crews_amalthea } value = 2 }
}
sr_disp_site_staffing_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_staffing_amalthea
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_hab_used_amalthea = { value = sr_mod_hab_used_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_hab_cap_amalthea = { value = sr_site_hab_cap_amalthea }
sr_disp_mod_past_amalthea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_hab_used_amalthea > sr_site_hab_cap_amalthea } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_amalthea = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_amalthea = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_amalthea multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_amalthea = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_base_room_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_amalthea = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_resort_room_amalthea = { value = sr_site_resort_room_amalthea }
sr_disp_site_resort_draw_amalthea = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_amalthea }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_amalthea = { value = 1 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_amalthea = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_amalthea floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_amalthea = { value = 10000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_crews_at_cap_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_people_at_cap_amalthea
	divide = 10000
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } multiply = 2 }
	floor = yes
}

sr_disp_site_crews_titan = { value = sr_site_crews_titan }
sr_disp_site_crews_short_titan = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crew_needed_titan > sr_site_crews_titan } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_crews_planned_titan = {
	value = sr_mod_crewed_pending_titan
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_crews_fit_titan = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_titan = sr_site_crews_titan } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_titan > sr_site_crews_titan } value = 2 }
}

	value = sr_site_staffing_titan
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}

sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_titan = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_titan }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_titan = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_titan multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_titan = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_titan multiply = sr_site_base_room_titan }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_titan = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_titan }

sr_disp_site_resort_draw_titan = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_titan }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_titan = { value = 3 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_titan = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_titan floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_titan = { value = 40000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }

sr_disp_site_hab_used_mimas = { value = sr_mod_hab_used_mimas }
sr_disp_site_hab_cap_mimas = { value = sr_site_hab_cap_mimas }
sr_disp_mod_past_mimas = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_hab_used_mimas > sr_site_hab_cap_mimas } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_mimas = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_mimas }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_mimas = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_mimas multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_mimas = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_mimas multiply = sr_site_base_room_mimas }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_mimas = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_mimas }
sr_disp_site_resort_room_mimas = { value = sr_site_resort_room_mimas }
sr_disp_site_resort_draw_mimas = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_mimas }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_mimas = { value = 1 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_mimas = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_mimas floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_mimas = { value = 10000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_crews_at_cap_mimas = {
	value = sr_site_people_at_cap_mimas
	divide = 10000
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } multiply = 2 }
	floor = yes
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_peary }

sr_disp_site_crews_needed_peary = { value = sr_site_crew_needed_peary }
sr_disp_site_crews_peary = { value = sr_site_crews_peary }
sr_disp_site_crews_short_peary = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crew_needed_peary > sr_site_crews_peary } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_crews_planned_peary = {
	value = sr_mod_crewed_pending_peary
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_crews_fit_peary = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_peary = sr_site_crews_peary } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_peary > sr_site_crews_peary } value = 2 }
}
sr_disp_site_staffing_peary = {
	value = sr_site_staffing_peary
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_hab_used_peary = { value = sr_mod_hab_used_peary }
sr_disp_site_hab_cap_peary = { value = sr_site_hab_cap_peary }
sr_disp_mod_past_peary = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_hab_used_peary > sr_site_hab_cap_peary } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_peary = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_peary }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_peary = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_peary multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_peary = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_peary multiply = sr_site_base_room_peary }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_peary = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_peary }
sr_disp_site_resort_room_peary = { value = sr_site_resort_room_peary }
sr_disp_site_resort_draw_peary = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_peary }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_peary = { value = 1 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_peary = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_peary floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_peary = { value = 15000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_crews_at_cap_peary = {
	value = sr_site_people_at_cap_peary
	divide = 10000
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } multiply = 2 }
	floor = yes
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_daedalus } add = var:sr_mq_black_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_daedalus }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_daedalus } add = var:sr_mq_train_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_daedalus }

sr_disp_site_crews_needed_daedalus = { value = sr_site_crew_needed_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_crews_daedalus = { value = sr_site_crews_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_crews_short_daedalus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crew_needed_daedalus > sr_site_crews_daedalus } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_crews_planned_daedalus = {
	value = sr_mod_crewed_pending_daedalus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_site_crews_fit_daedalus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_daedalus = sr_site_crews_daedalus } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_site_crews_planned_daedalus > sr_site_crews_daedalus } value = 2 }
}
sr_disp_site_staffing_daedalus = {
	value = sr_site_staffing_daedalus
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_hab_used_daedalus = { value = sr_mod_hab_used_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_hab_cap_daedalus = { value = sr_site_hab_cap_daedalus }
sr_disp_mod_past_daedalus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_hab_used_daedalus > sr_site_hab_cap_daedalus } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_mod_next_hab_cost_daedalus = { value = sr_mod_next_hab_cost_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_hab_share_daedalus = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_daedalus multiply = 100 round = yes }
sr_disp_site_hab_people_daedalus = { value = sr_site_hab_share_value_daedalus multiply = sr_site_base_room_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_ebase_room_daedalus = { value = sr_site_ebase_room_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_resort_room_daedalus = { value = sr_site_resort_room_daedalus }
sr_disp_site_resort_draw_daedalus = { value = sr_site_resort_draw_daedalus }
sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_daedalus = { value = 1 }
sr_disp_ss_people_at_cap_daedalus = { value = sr_site_people_at_cap_daedalus floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_people_room_daedalus = { value = 10000 multiply = sr_our_room_mult floor = yes }
sr_disp_ss_crews_at_cap_daedalus = {
	value = sr_site_people_at_cap_daedalus
	divide = 10000
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } multiply = 2 }
	floor = yes
}

# Terraforming (era 13 spec § 7.11), per colony on a world that takes it:
#   sr_disp_terra_shown_<key>  1 once we have the technology, or the colony has
#                              levels or levels on their way, or its world work done
#   sr_disp_terra_pct_<key>    the room its world's work has added to it, in percent
#                              of its base
# and per world (world_of):
#   sr_disp_terra_state_<world>  0 no work going on, 1 under way, 2 finished
#   sr_disp_terra_years_<world>  the years left at this month's pace, every colony's
#                                there (under way), at most 999
sr_disp_terra_shown_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				modifier:country_sr_terraforming_bool = yes
				sr_site_terra_value_valles_marineris > 0
				sr_world_terra_done_value_mars > 0
				sr_disp_mod_pending_terra_valles_marineris > 0
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}
sr_disp_terra_pct_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_terra_share_valles_marineris
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_terra_shown_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				modifier:country_sr_terraforming_bool = yes
				sr_site_terra_value_olympus_mons > 0
				sr_world_terra_done_value_mars > 0
				sr_disp_mod_pending_terra_olympus_mons > 0
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}
sr_disp_terra_pct_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_terra_share_olympus_mons
	multiply = 100
	floor = yes
}

sr_disp_terra_state_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_world_terra_open_mars = yes } } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_world_terra_rate_mars > 0 } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_terra_years_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_world_terra_rate_mars > 0 sr_world_terra_open_mars = yes }
		value = sr_world_terra_full_mars
		subtract = sr_world_terra_done_value_mars
		divide = sr_world_terra_rate_mars
		divide = 12
		ceiling = yes
		max = 999
	}
}

	value = 0

sr_disp_terra_years_moon = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_world_terra_rate_moon > 0 sr_world_terra_open_moon = yes }
		value = sr_world_terra_full_moon
		subtract = sr_world_terra_done_value_moon
		divide = sr_world_terra_rate_moon
		divide = 12
		ceiling = yes
		max = 999
	}
}

# Colony Autonomy (slice 5 design § 9), per world:
#   sr_disp_site_aut_<key>        its autonomy, whole
#   sr_disp_site_aut_drift_<key>  its drift a month, ours only (0 otherwise)
#   sr_disp_site_aut_status_<key> 0 nothing, 1 chartered, 2 garrisoned, 3 both
#   sr_disp_site_held_<key>       1 while ours and held at the break level by force
#                                 (sr_site_hold_<key>): the status cell says so instead
#   sr_disp_hold_<fig>_<key>      a hold's figures, ours only: marines, need, loss
#                                 (the world's) a month, months it holds, and 1 while
#                                 it loses nothing (steady)
#   sr_disp_free_<key>            1 while it is a free colony
#   sr_disp_free_ties_<key>       our ties with it, whole
#   sr_disp_free_supplied_<key>   1 while we supply it
sr_disp_site_aut_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this } value = sr_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris }
}
sr_disp_site_aut_status_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris } add = 2 }
}
sr_disp_site_held_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris } value = 1 } }
sr_disp_hold_marines_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris } value = sr_site_hold_marines_valles_marineris } }
sr_disp_hold_need_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris } value = sr_site_hold_need_valles_marineris } }
sr_disp_hold_loss_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris } value = sr_site_hold_world_loss_valles_marineris } }
sr_disp_hold_months_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris } value = sr_site_hold_months_valles_marineris } }
sr_disp_hold_steady_valles_marineris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_resisting_valles_marineris sr_site_hold_world_loss_valles_marineris <= 0 } value = 1 } }
sr_disp_free_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_free_ties_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_free_supplied_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}

# A colony's autonomy drift by term (audit SPC-15: its drift hover lists its own
# terms): its people, its distance by our drive, a year without contact, and 1
# while it has too few people for any of them to count (sr_disp_aut_unpeopled). The
# country's terms (a war, a colony we destroyed) are sr_disp_aut_war and
# sr_disp_aut_destroyed; the flat ones are constants.
sr_disp_aut_people_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
sr_disp_aut_distance_valles_marineris = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
sr_disp_aut_nocontact_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris > sr_aut_no_contact_months } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_aut_settle_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate multiply = -1 }
sr_disp_aut_admin_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_valles_marineris multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
sr_disp_aut_unpeopled_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_site_peopled_valles_marineris = yes } } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_aut_target_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this } value = sr_site_aut_pressure_valles_marineris divide = sr_aut_settle_rate }
	min = 0
	max = sr_aut_break_level
	floor = yes
}

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this } value = sr_site_aut_pressure_imbrium divide = sr_aut_settle_rate }
	min = 0
	max = sr_aut_break_level
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_aut_war = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_aut_destroyed = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } value = 1 }
}

# Our Habitat share, in percent: what a Habitat would hold of a world's starting
# room were the world ours (the Solar System hovers).
sr_disp_our_hab_share = { value = 0.5 add = modifier:country_sr_habitat_room_add multiply = 100 round = yes }

# Our next colony fleet's target (var:sr_cf_target, a world's index): its Habitat
# cap and the people and crews it would hold there (the target line's hover).
sr_disp_cf_target_hab_cap = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_valles_marineris }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_olympus_mons }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_hellas_planitia }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_utopia_planitia }

		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_vesta }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 } value = sr_disp_ss_hab_cap_psyche }

# Next Windows (colony management design § 6), per destination, the viewer's scope:
#   sr_disp_win_row_<body>    sr_window_reach_<body>: 1 shown, 2 beyond our drive, 0 neither
#   sr_disp_win_state_<body>  0 any month (no window, or a drive windows don't bind),
#                             1 its window is open, 2 waiting, 3 waiting with propellant
#                             depots (the premium to go now)
# and the table's counts.
sr_disp_win_row_moon = { value = sr_window_reach_moon }
sr_disp_win_state_moon = { value = 0 }
sr_disp_win_row_mars = { value = sr_window_reach_mars }
sr_disp_win_premium_mars = { value = sr_window_premium_country_mars max = 9.99 }
sr_disp_win_state_mars = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_launch_windows_apply = yes } } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_is_open_mars } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_has_depots = yes } value = 3 }
}

# ---- The Bases view (Extraplanetary Base ground types design § 9.1), from

# A level's output is for the method most of our mining levels run (var:sr_eb_lead_method,
# its place in the group's mining methods; the group's first with none): the basket times
# that method's scale (§ 7).

	value = 0.44564

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_lead_method var:sr_eb_lead_method = 3 } value = 5 }
}

# 0 while some place serving us earns money a level at the refresh's prices; 1 when every
# one loses money (§ 8.3: nothing moves). The first that earns ends the search.
sr_disp_eb_all_lose = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { has_technology_researched = asteroid_mining sr_disp_eb_profit_near_earth > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } sr_disp_eb_profit_valles_marineris > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_olympus_mons } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons } sr_disp_eb_profit_olympus_mons > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hellas_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia } sr_disp_eb_profit_hellas_planitia > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_utopia_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia } sr_disp_eb_profit_utopia_planitia > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_arcadia_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia } sr_disp_eb_profit_arcadia_planitia > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ceres } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ceres } sr_disp_eb_profit_ceres > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_vesta } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_vesta } sr_disp_eb_profit_vesta > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_psyche } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_psyche } sr_disp_eb_profit_psyche > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_pallas } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pallas } sr_disp_eb_profit_pallas > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hygiea } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea } sr_disp_eb_profit_hygiea > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_io } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io } sr_disp_eb_profit_io > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_europa } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_europa } sr_disp_eb_profit_europa > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ganymede } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ganymede } sr_disp_eb_profit_ganymede > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_callisto } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_callisto } sr_disp_eb_profit_callisto > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_himalia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_himalia } sr_disp_eb_profit_himalia > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_amalthea } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_amalthea } sr_disp_eb_profit_amalthea > 0 }

				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ariel } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } sr_disp_eb_profit_ariel > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_triton } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_triton } sr_disp_eb_profit_triton > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_proteus } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_proteus } sr_disp_eb_profit_proteus > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_pluto } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pluto } sr_disp_eb_profit_pluto > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_eris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_eris } sr_disp_eb_profit_eris > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_makemake } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_makemake } sr_disp_eb_profit_makemake > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_haumea } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_haumea } sr_disp_eb_profit_haumea > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_sedna } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_sedna } sr_disp_eb_profit_sedna > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_shackleton } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_shackleton } sr_disp_eb_profit_shackleton > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_peary ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_peary } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_peary } sr_disp_eb_profit_peary > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_tranquility } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_tranquility } sr_disp_eb_profit_tranquility > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_marius_hills } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_marius_hills } sr_disp_eb_profit_marius_hills > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_daedalus } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_daedalus } sr_disp_eb_profit_daedalus > 0 }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_imbrium } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_imbrium } sr_disp_eb_profit_imbrium > 0 }
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
# A level's profit at the current move's source and destination (§ 9.1's move line;
# the destination's is read by the hand-written sr_disp_eb_gap only).
sr_disp_eb_move_from_profit = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_move_from }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_from = 0 } value = sr_disp_eb_profit_near_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_from = 1 } value = sr_disp_eb_profit_valles_marineris }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_from = 2 } value = sr_disp_eb_profit_olympus_mons }

	}
}
sr_eb_view_move_to_profit = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_move_to }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_to = 0 } value = sr_disp_eb_profit_near_earth }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_to = 1 } value = sr_disp_eb_profit_valles_marineris }

# The overview's Extraplanetary Base cell (UI pass design § 8; design § 9): our levels,
# our room for them, and the throughput the room gives them (percent, the average grade;
# negative past the room); levels queued and not yet built; the grade the next level
# would work at (the refresh's, queued levels counted); 1 once built and queued
# levels pass the room; and 1 once the building is ours to build (its technology).
sr_disp_ebase_levels = {
	value = sr_ebase_levels
}
sr_disp_ebase_room = {
	value = sr_ebase_room_total
}
sr_disp_ebase_grade = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ebase_grade } value = var:sr_ebase_grade }
}
sr_disp_ebase_queued = {
	value = sr_ebase_queued_levels
	subtract = sr_ebase_levels
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_ebase_next_grade = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ebase_next_grade } value = var:sr_ebase_next_grade }
	# Live past all of the room, where the refresh's figure would lag a freshly
	# queued batch (or read 0 before any refresh has run).
	if = { limit = { sr_ebase_queued_levels >= sr_ebase_room_total } value = -75 }
}
sr_disp_ebase_past = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_ebase_queued_levels > sr_ebase_room_total } value = 1 }
}
# The cell's word counts queued levels as well as built ones, as its red and
# "next at" do: "built +queued / room" while levels are queued and the three
# figures fit the cell's column ("9999 +999 / 9999" at the longest), and
# otherwise their sum against the room (owner, 2026-11-04: "0 / 75" in red,
# with more than 75 levels queued, hid the queue that made it red).
sr_disp_ebase_total = {
	value = sr_ebase_levels
	add = sr_disp_ebase_queued
}
sr_disp_ebase_split = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_disp_ebase_queued > 0
			sr_disp_ebase_queued < 1000
			sr_disp_ebase_levels < 10000
			sr_disp_ebase_room < 10000
		}
		value = 1
	}
}
sr_disp_ebase_shown = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = in_situ_resource_utilization } value = 1 }
}

# The overview's Resort Colony cell (UI pass design § 8; #1948 design § 6): our levels,
# our room for them, and the throughput the room gives them (percent, the average draw;
# negative past the room); levels queued and not yet built; the draw the next level
# would work at (the refresh's, queued levels counted); 1 once built and queued
# levels pass the room; and 1 once the building is ours to build (its technology).
sr_disp_resort_levels = {
	value = sr_resort_levels
}
sr_disp_resort_room = {
	value = sr_resort_room_total
}
sr_disp_resort_draw = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_resort_draw } value = var:sr_resort_draw }
}
sr_disp_resort_queued = {
	value = sr_resort_queued_levels
	subtract = sr_resort_levels
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_resort_next_draw = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_resort_next_draw } value = var:sr_resort_next_draw }
	# Live past all of the room, where the refresh's figure would lag a freshly
	# queued batch (or read 0 before any refresh has run).
	if = { limit = { sr_resort_queued_levels >= sr_resort_room_total } value = -75 }
}
sr_disp_resort_past = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_resort_queued_levels > sr_resort_room_total } value = 1 }
}
# The cell's word counts queued levels as well as built ones, as its red and
# "next at" do: "built +queued / room" while levels are queued and the three
# figures fit the cell's column ("9999 +999 / 9999" at the longest), and
# otherwise their sum against the room (owner, 2026-11-04: "0 / 75" in red,
# with more than 75 levels queued, hid the queue that made it red).
sr_disp_resort_total = {
	value = sr_resort_levels
	add = sr_disp_resort_queued
}
sr_disp_resort_split = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_disp_resort_queued > 0
			sr_disp_resort_queued < 1000
			sr_disp_resort_levels < 10000
			sr_disp_resort_room < 10000
		}
		value = 1
	}
}
sr_disp_resort_shown = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = space_colonization } value = 1 }
}
